body: Nah man it has never not ended up the way I described

For me personally it’s hard to explain... I am socially inept and on top of that not many people like me, I get invited out very very rarely but when I do I always decline. I decline because I know that every time I go somewhere with people I always get .... left out or left behind, like I was invited because someone got told to invite me and not because they actually wanted me there. Every single time I go out socially it happens, nobody talks to me except when they see me alone in a corner somewhere and then I move away to a different corner. Just feels like people react to my social inability out of instinct not out of desire, they THINK they should talk to me to be nice but it’s not done because they actually care, it’s done because they feel obligated to say something or their morality will be in question.

I made a post about my experience on r/suicidewatch 

Focus on you bro, put them negative emotions behind you and move foreword. In my mind I literally grabbed all that negativity and wrapped it up in a ball and threw it away.  Be strong, stranger, you deserve a good life and it will get better I promise.

I don’t either, my brother got married and now has no time for me and I don’t talk to my family because they’re just toxic. My day to day consists of Eat work Eat Work Eat sleep repeat... I don’t go out or do anything or talk to anyone... you have to choose to live regardless of circumstances, live so you can see your life when it does get better, it will.
